sentences.en: The battlefield was full of the dead and the dying.
sentences.zh: 战场上到处都是死者和垂死的人。

sentences.en: The boy dyed his hair because he wanted to be noticed.
sentences.zh: 这个男孩染了头发因为他想引起注意。

sentences.en: People living in this area are dying for want of water.
sentences.zh: 居住在这个地区的人们因为缺水而濒临死亡。
